summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and one parametrized test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed), and the full test/test_extras run passes (97 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). None and plain-string inputs raise SHACLPathError. Nothing was committed, and no other files changed. mypy and ruff are not in the shared venv, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only; if warn_unused_ignores flags any of them, check those lines first.
